<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex019062026-07-0605-50-24" status="unreviewed">'on na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3771">phyogs kyi glang po</rs> lasogs pa mkhas pa rnams kyis tshad ma'i bstan bcos byas pa don myed par 'gyur ro zhe na |
          mu stegs rgol ba bzlog pa'i phyir <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">bud dha</foreign>'i bstan pa srung ba la mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa yin | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs>s 'di bzhin du gsungs <lb n="10a2"/> mtshan nyid pa dag tshad ma ba dang grub mtha' ba zer nas blo zhib shos dang rtsing shos gnyis su byed pa la | spyir tshad ma bya ba grub mtha'i yan lag yin pas | phyi rol ba nas dbu' ma'i bar thams cad kyis gzhan gyi phyogs sun 'byin pa dang | rang gi phyogs sgrub pa thams cad tshad mas byas <lb n="10a3"/> par 'dod pa yin la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs>s gsungs pa 'di yang yin te | chos nyid rtogs pa nyid de gnyis las 'byung ba yin na skyon 'di dag gnas pa kho na yin la | zla ba ston pa'i mdzub mo bzhin du dang po thos bsams gyis bden pa gnyis gtan la 'bebs pa de gnyis kho nas byas pa yin te | <lb n="10a4"/> 'og nas rigs pas brtag na ces pa'o | |</seg></TEI>
